html:
Sapa is a year-round tourist destination, in autumn Sapa seems to put on a charming cloak, a shimmering yellow color, or wild flowers competing to show off their bright colors, in the distance is a simple and rustic village but exudes a unique beauty, as if to urge the footsteps of travelers.

When is the best time to travel to Sapa?

Sapa has cool weather all year round, however, to avoid encountering stormy seasons, visitors should not go from late June to August, because Sapa is a mountainous area, so there will be flash floods and landslides. If you go during this time, visitors should listen to the weather in advance to have a convenient tour, because this is the rainy season, so the number of visitors to Sapa will be low, the services will not be as crowded as in the peak season. Therefore, visitors will go to the attractions and not have to queue and the services will be lower than in the peak season.

Traveling to Sapa from February to May, visitors will be immersed in the colors of flowers such as cherry blossoms, peach blossoms, plum blossoms… visitors can take beautiful pictures of Sapa’s flower season.

If visitors want to avoid the heat, travel to Sapa from June to August, because the weather in Sapa is relatively cool. However, visitors should check the weather in advance to make their trip more convenient.

Traveling to Sapa from September to November, visitors will be satisfied with the golden season of Sapa, a yellow color winding around the mountainside, bringing a poetic beauty, surrounded by cool green forests, and the yellow color of terraced fields, in the distance are the stilt houses hidden on the mountainside.

Traveling to Sapa in the winter from December to February of the following year, the winter in Sapa is quite cold, visitors will be able to play with white snow on the mountain top.

Transportation to Sapa

Tourists can choose to go by car or motorbike, if they want to rest on the bus, they can take a sleeper bus to Sapa. However, most backpackers and backpackers in Sapa often choose motorbikes to both travel and sightsee.

Where to stay in Sapa

Sapa has many accommodation services for tourists to choose from homestay, hotel, resort… however, it all depends on your budget, if you want to experience close to nature, choose homestay.

Where to visit when traveling to Sapa?

Ham Rong Mountain

Located at an altitude of 1,450m above sea level, from the top of the mountain, visitors can see the whole beauty of Sapa from above, a majestic scene is an indispensable destination in the Sapa tour itinerary.

Sapa Stone Church

An ancient church, most beautiful on Christmas nights, in the dim lights, visitors should take a walk to admire the beauty of the mountain town, a truly beautiful scene that this place brings to visitors.

Cat Cat Village

This place is mainly inhabited by Mong people, coming here visitors not only visit the scenic spots but also experience daily life with the people of the Northwest highlands such as weaving, silver carving, jewelry making… surrounded by Tien Sa stream, Vang stream and Bac stream.

Lao Chai – Ta Van

A peaceful scene, the people here are mainly Mong, Dao, Giay… surrounded by terraced fields, the most beautiful in autumn, the fields stretch out in a golden color, surrounded by peaceful streams.

Fansipan Peak

When coming here, visitors should experience the cable car, sitting in the cabin, visitors can see the beauty of Sapa from above, especially the season of blooming flowers stretching out…

Swing Sapa

A destination that many tourists come to, especially young people who come here not only to visit but also to take beautiful pictures as souvenirs on their Sapa tour.

Séo My Ty Lake

To reach the lake, visitors must cross the forest to reach the lake with a calm water surface, looking from above the lake looks like a calm silk sheet.

Heaven’s Gate

Conquering the O Quy Ho pass, visitors will reach the Heaven’s Gate of Sapa, from above visitors can admire the vast scenery of the Northwest mountains and forests.

O Quy Ho Pass

This is a fairly long pass connecting the two provinces of Lao Cai – Lai Chau, the most beautiful is when the sunrise or sunset, the whole pass exudes a poetic beauty that looks like a beautiful picture.

Silver Waterfall – Love Waterfall

The most beautiful place to hide from the sun in the Sapa summer tour, the higher the waterfall, the cooler it gets, in the rainy season the waterfall is even more beautiful, looking from afar like a long silk sheet, exuding a unique beauty in the mountain town.

What to eat when traveling to Sapa?

Sapa not only welcomes visitors with famous landscapes, but when coming here, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes such as: pork, chicken, vegetable rolls to eggs, corn, potatoes, bamboo rice… all bring diners the delicious flavor of the Northwest mountains.
